channel.title: Fands Field Notes
channel.description: Practical notes on putting AI to work in a small or mid-size business.

item.title: Win the job in the first five minutes.
item.description: Why the speed of your first reply decides who gets the job, and a practical plan to answer every new lead in minutes.

item.title: How to get your business named in AI answers.
item.description: People now ask ChatGPT and Google for a recommendation. A practical checklist for local businesses to be the answer.

item.title: Workflow or AI agent? Pick the simplest thing that works.
item.description: Not every problem needs an agent. A plain-English guide to choosing between a workflow and an agent, and why simple usually wins.

item.title: How to measure AI ROI without a data team.
item.description: A baseline, one metric and a monthly review. A simple method for proving that an AI project paid for itself.

item.title: Keep a person in control: guardrails for AI workflows.
item.description: Six guardrails that stop an AI workflow from doing something you did not intend, and why a document can be an attack.

item.title: A weekly content engine for a business with no marketing team.
item.description: One idea, five formats, one hour a week. How to stay visible with AI drafting and your voice deciding.

item.title: Your first AI workflow should be boring.
item.description: A practical scorecard for choosing your first AI project, measuring the baseline and deciding whether it earned the next step.
